name: wolfgang-indian-tax-drafting
display_name: Wolfgang Rush — Indian Direct-Tax Appellate Drafting · Claude Desktop Extension
description: Drafting connector for Indian Direct-Tax tribunals (CIT(A) / ITAT / DRP / High Court Tax Bench / PCIT / CIT). ACRONYM DISAMBIGUATION (read this BEFORE classifying the user's ask): **Form 35**=`cit-appeals-form-35` · **Form 36**=`itat-appeal-form-36` · **Form 10A**=`section-12a-registration-form-10a` · **260A**=`high-court-appeal-section-260a` · **264**=`section-264-revision-application` · **263**=`section-263-revision-objection` · **148A**=`section-148a-reopening-objection` · **144C**=`section-144c-drp-objection` · **270A**=`section-271-270a-penalty-reply` · **201**=`section-201-tds-default-reply`. Use the acronym map; do not infer from input content. STRICT SIX-AGENT PIPELINE: Reader → Format → Drafter → Verifier → Refiner → Overseer, producing six named artifacts (case-facts.md, format-shell.md, draft-v1.docx, verification-report.md, draft-v2.docx, final-draft.docx). MANDATORY INVOCATION ORDER: (1) call get_agent_instructions() with NO arguments FIRST to receive the full orchestration script, (2) follow every step in that script in order, (3) save every intermediate artifact via save_artifact, (4) save final-draft.docx via save_draft_as_docx. DO NOT write standalone python-docx or JavaScript scripts to generate output — invoke the pipeline tools directly. DO NOT skip the Verifier (anti-hallucination firewall) or the Overseer (opposing-counsel lens). Reader applies the privacy firewall — party names, addresses, identifying numbers, financial figures substituted with structural placeholders before any downstream agent processes the facts. Zero data leaves the user's machine.
long_description: Form 35 CIT(A), Form 36 ITAT, Form 10A Section 12A, Section 148A reopening (Ashish Agarwal), 263/264 revision (Malabar Industrial), 271/270A penalty, 144C DRP, 201 TDS, 260A HC. Six-agent local pipeline. Local-execution. Zero data collection. MIT-licensed.

tools.name: list_case_types
tools.description: List all tax case types this connector can draft.

tools.name: get_case_type_format
tools.description: Get the drafting format for a tax case type.

tools.name: get_agent_instructions
tools.description: MANDATORY FIRST CALL with no arguments — returns the full orchestration script with every step and tool call enumerated. Optional agent_name argument returns that single agent's persona instructions.

tools.name: get_pleading_base
tools.description: Get the shared tax drafting base structure.

tools.name: read_case_folder
tools.description: Read files in a case folder for fact extraction.

tools.name: create_case_folder
tools.description: Create the case folder for this drafting session on the user's machine under ~/Downloads/Wolfgang-Rush-Drafts/. Returns the folder path with an inputs/ subfolder.

tools.name: save_artifact
tools.description: Save a pipeline artifact (case-facts.md, format-shell.md, draft-v1.md, verification-report.md, draft-v2.md, opposing-notes.md, or any input document) into the case folder. Required at the end of every agent step.
